name: Brad Knott

items.text: WRAL reported in February 2024 that Knott was registered to vote at his parents' Raleigh address from 2010 to 2023. He voted in five general elections from that address after buying his own home in 2014. Knott said it "slipped my mind" and called it a paperwork issue. WRAL said no one had challenged his ballots.
items.why: He admits the registration error, but no official finding, challenge or charge followed, and nothing shows he knowingly misstated his address, so it doesn't clearly bear on any criterion.

for_review: The Anderson Alerts/Caucus article is paywalled, and I could not open its records link. The search on the owner's named sites returned nothing about Knott. I did not read any records from the state or Wake County elections boards directly. WRAL says neither board had received a challenge to his ballots. Wake County DA Lorrin Freeman did not comment on Knott, and I found no report of an investigation. Attendance was not weighed, as instructed.
